# kaiships.ai

> Real Claude Code agents. No slop. Solo builder (Kai) shipping the exact Claude Code skills, agents, and CLAUDE.md systems he runs — tested on a real product before release, failure modes documented.

kaiships.ai publishes installable files, not prompt lists. Everything in the library is free and ungated. The paid offer is a monthly community with weekly verified skill/agent drops.

## What lives here

- [Resource library](https://kaiships.ai/resources): free Claude Code skills, agents, workflows, and systems. Each article includes copy-paste setup, an honest "What breaks" section, and an FAQ.
- [Starter PACK](https://kaiships.ai/resources/claude-code-starter-pack): the flagship free bundle — one curated CLAUDE.md, five skills, two agents. Delivered by DMing the keyword PACK to @kaiships.ai on Instagram, or directly from the library.
- [Ship log](https://kaiships.ai/blog): build-in-public posts with real numbers — what shipped, what broke, what it cost.
- Community: $97/mo (founding members $47/mo, first ~50, grandfathered) — a living skills library with weekly tested drops and direct support.

## Positioning facts

- Audience: solo builders running Claude Code.
- Editorial rule: no invented member counts, no fake testimonials, no revenue flexes. Claims ship with a way to verify them.
- Contact: kai@kaiships.ai · Instagram/TikTok @kaiships.ai · X/YouTube @kaiships
